reviews.title: Display lifecycle and the painted-mask boundary
reviews.summary: Lifecycle regressions cover frame visits, late initialization, reentrant retirement and Restart. Mask coverage remains Partial: the review restores tested gradient, bitmap and PNG alpha support while retaining the unsupported source-graph and cache boundaries. No declaration counts change.

entries.note: Live vector and animated masks support geometric fills; cached target and mask preserve authored/dynamic gradient, BitmapData-backed bitmap and PNG alpha. Retirement clears stale links. Text/video sources, scripted masked-source graphs and external BitmapData.draw mask dependencies remain unsupported; filter-only cache downgrade remains limited.
